posts.title: Hasn't it just been forever?
posts.description: A. B. Hi Rejects : It's been three years since I posted last. I've struggled with Long COVID all these years and am finally feeling much better. Symptoms have lessened greatly, though I still have to watch out for overdoing my activities and I still haven't gotten my running shoes or my yoga blocks back out.
